PermissionType.description_en:
The permission type. Valid values are:

ReadOnly: read-only access.

ReadWrite: Allows users to edit and run.

FullAccess: full control.

NoPrivilege: no permissions.

CustomPermissions: custom permissions
PermissionType.description_zh:

ReadOnly：只读
ReadWrite：可编辑/运行
FullAccess：完全控制
NoPrivilege：无权限
CustomPermissions: 自定义权限

Permissions.description_en: The permissions. This parameter is required and applies only when `PermissionType` is set to `CustomPermissions`
Permissions.description_zh: 权限列表。仅PermissionType为CustomPermissions时才有效，且必填

items.description_en: The permission code. Each permission must be unique within the region. For more information about permissions, see [Appendix: Roles and permissions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2840449.html）
items.description_zh: 权限点的名字，同地域内唯一。权限点介绍，请参见[附录：角色及权限列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2840449.html）

Accessibility.description_en:
The access type. Valid values are:

PUBLIC: All members in the current workspace can perform this action.

PRIVATE: Only the creator can perform this action.

ANY: Both the creator and non-creators can perform this action
Accessibility.description_zh:
访问类型，可能值：
PUBLIC：当前工作空间所有成员都可以操作。
PRIVATE：只有创建者可以操作。
ANY：创建者和非创建者都可以操作
Accessibility.title: Accessibility

EntityAccessType.description_en:
The entity access type. This parameter is ignored if `Accessibility` is set to `PUBLIC`. If `Accessibility` is set to `PRIVATE`, the value of this parameter determines the permissions. Valid values are:

CREATOR: Only the creator can perform this action.

ANY: Both the creator and non-creators can perform this action
EntityAccessType.description_zh:
存取类型。 当 Accessibility 为 PUBLIC，所有用户都能操作，此值无效； 当 Accessibility 为 PRIVATE 时，根据 EntityAccessType 的值决定权限，EntityAccessType 支持如下值：
CREATOR：只有创建者可以操作。
ANY：创建者和非创建者都可以操作
